verdict.rationale: Sandbox or test environments are a fair question for an auth service, but the evidence pack never documents one for Supabase Auth: no test mode, no branching or preview environments, and no isolated dev projects. The self-hosting docs describe running your own Supabase instance, but they never present this as a way to test without touching production data. That makes it at most an adjacent user-side arrangement, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
